description: SUPARCO Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission is a data repository run by SUPARCO, Pakistan. The national space agency publishes satellite-based flood, drought and land-use monitoring products and remote-sensing data services for Pakistan. Coverage: Pakistan. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account.
